Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
 08.10.2024
 Court No.29
 Item No.19
 Allowed
 ar
 Crm (A) 3658 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Sect
 Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the 
 Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Dhantala Poli
 614 of 2024 dated 25.08.2024 corresponding to Serial No
Section 376/417 of the Indian Penal Code.
 And
 In Re: Priyajit Majumder @ Babai
 Petitioner
 Ms. Minoti Gomes
 Mr. Sananda Bhattacharyya For the Petitione
 Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee
 Ms. Nahid Ahmed For the State

1.
Affidavit of service filed in Court is taken on record.
2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
3. In spite of service, the victim is not represented.

4. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the fact that the prosecutrix is a married lady and prima facie there appears to be consensual relationship between two adult persons and the allegation of promise to marry in the background of the facts that the prosecutrix is married, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

5. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, namely, Priyajit Majumder @
Babai shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-,with two registered sureties of Section 376/417 Of The Indian Penal Code vs In Re: Priyajit Majumder @ Babai on 8 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163388143/
1 like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Signed By :
AMITAVA ROY High Court of Calcutta 8 th of October 2024 03:08:40 PM Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.

The petitioner shall meet with the I.O once in a fortnight till the submission of the final report and on further condition that the petitioner shall appear before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranaghat, Nadia, within three weeks from date in connection with Serial No. 912 of 2024.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranaghat, Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the event of non-compliance of any of the conditions, the anticipatory bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
6. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is allowed and the same is accordingly disposed of.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
